# Phantom

> The open-source engineering agent workbench that runs all engineering, manages resources, and coordinates local and cloud fleets through a CLI, MCP server, and web console.

## Start

- [Phantom](README.md): The open-source engineering agent workbench by AshlrAI — connect agents, work interactively, or hand the fleet an outcome.
- [Quickstart](QUICKSTART.md): Install Phantom, enroll a repo, start a resident fleet and publish its work in distinct steps.
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): TypeScript/ESM CLI and SDK plus a React web console; `phm` and `ashlr` share one launcher.
- [Agent Operations](AGENT-OPERATIONS.md): Cold-start checklist for building, installing, and operating Phantom from source.

## CLI

- [CLI Reference](CLI-REFERENCE.md): Generated from `phm --help` and `phm help --all` output; commands are the checkout authority.
- [CLI Docs](cli.md): Regenerated from `phm --help` output by `scripts/generate-cli-docs.mjs`; do not edit by hand.
- [CLI Contracts](AGENT-CLI-CONTRACTS.md): CLI interface contracts and command-level guarantees.

## MCP and agents

- [Fleet MCP Onramp](FLEET-MCP-ONRAMP.md): Standalone fleet MCP server — add a minimal stdio server entry to any client config.
- [Companions](COMPANIONS.md): Inspect Phantom Secrets, Locus, and Lexicon — separately installed, not bundled.
- [Agent-Native Quickstart](AGENT-NATIVE-QUICKSTART.md): Use the desktop `/verse/` console as visibility and control surface for sessions and fleet observations.
- [Plugins](PLUGINS.md): Extend Phantom with backlog scanners, templates, model providers, and CLI commands without forking.

## Fleet

- [Fleet API](FLEET-API.md): Loopback HTTP endpoints exposing projections for desktop, phone, and Leader coordination.
- [Cloud Lane](CLOUD.md): Start Claude Code cloud sessions from chat, Command, or CLI; Phantom can also start them itself.
- [Drive](DRIVE.md): Mac queue supervisor running serial ticks, reaping workers, and admitting READY jobs.
- [Hub Reference](HUB-REFERENCE.md): Universe, resource pools, and the legacy fleet — compatibility identifiers retained.
